views.description: Upper-left plan view of the rounded rectangular hole-entry face: four mounting through holes and two concentric blind-hole/counterbore pairs. Cutting plane A-A passes through the right blind hole, with arrows directed left.
views.centerline_notes: Centerlines locate both mounting-hole rows and columns and both blind-hole axes. Blind holes lie on a common row 0.94 below the upper mounting-hole row. No explicit edge offsets or overall-body symmetry dimensions are supplied.

views.description: Lower-left rectangular elevation showing overall width and thickness. Hidden lines show a mounting through hole and the left stepped blind hole, including its drill point. The two-place drilling/counterboring note leads to the top entry face.
views.centerline_notes: Projected blind-hole centerline aligns with the top view. Surface-texture symbol 63 applies to the upper entry face.

views.description: SECTION A-A, at the right of the top view. Full section through the right blind-hole axis shows solid hatching, shallow counterbore, smaller blind drilled cylinder, and conical drill point. No additional numeric dimensions.
views.centerline_notes: Horizontal centerline through the stepped blind hole confirms coaxial counterbore and drilled bore.

features.description: Rectangular base, 3.25 wide by 2.75 front-to-back, extruded 1.5 thick. Rounded plan corners are a separate final feature.
Seed mounting hole, diameter 0.40 through the full thickness. Absolute edge position is not explicitly dimensioned.
Two-by-two rectangular mounting-hole pattern, 2.38 horizontal and 1.88 vertical center spacing; four total holes including seed.

Left blind drilled hole, diameter 0.58 and stated depth 0.50, with conical drill point. Axis is 1.88 left of the right mounting-hole column and 0.94 below the upper mounting-hole row. Drill-point angle and depth convention require confirmation.
Second blind drilled hole 1.38 to the right of the seed on the same row. Two total blind drilled holes.
Two coaxial shallow counterbores at the blind drilled holes. Diameter limits read 1.002–1.012; depth limits interpreted as 0.111–0.113. Verify suspect callout before building.
Four rounded external plan corners extending through the body thickness. Radius is not dimensioned; do not choose a production radius from image scale.

General tolerance block contains no readable numeric tolerances. Zero default tolerance fields must not be interpreted as requirements for zero manufacturing tolerance.

Mounting-hole pattern is not explicitly located from the body edges. Consequently edge-referenced instance_positions are left empty for both hole callouts. Relative layout is constrained, but its absolute position on the block requires confirmation.

If and only if the hole layout is centered on the body, mounting-hole edge margins would be (3.25 - 2.38)/2 = 0.435 horizontally and (2.75 - 1.88)/2 = 0.435 vertically. This assumption has not been used as a controlling dimension.

Counterbore diameter limits read 1.012/1.002, but the illustrated outer circles and section show a much smaller step relative to the 0.58 drilled bore. Printed dimensions take precedence over scale; verify this callout against the original.
Counterbore depth stack appears .111 over .113, reversing conventional limit order. The interpreted range requires human confirmation.
H002 counterbore diameter 1.007 and depth 0.112 are calculated midpoints for representation only; D012 and D013 preserve the interpreted controlling limits.
Four exterior corner radii are visible but undimensioned. No chamfer dimensions are given.
Blind-hole drill-point angle and the precise meaning of the stated 0.50 drill depth are not defined.
Surface-texture value 63 is readable; microinch units are inferred from inch drafting practice. The nearby character appears G but is not confidently interpreted.
